title: Motif Binding — Campbell Stage → Thompson Motif Classes (macro x micro)
source: authored synthesis for monomyth (Campbell 1949 x Thompson motif-index classes)
tier_note: Binds the macro arc directly to the micro tier: no crosswalk artifact previously bound Campbell stages to Thompson motif classes (the framework corpus otherwise stops at Propp/Polti for the meso tier), so this hand-authored pairing is grounded in Thompson's own class glosses rather than an invented taxonomy. Each stage maps to the Thompson motif-class candidates a beat on that stage may plausibly realize (priors, not laws); a beat may still realize zero motifs if the seeded subset draw comes up empty. ADR-0022 Phase S2 adds a `motif_class_weights` array (permille, `0..=1000`) parallel to `motif_class_ids`; all entries are currently `1000` (all-FULL), so weighted selection is behaviorally uniform until real scholarship weights are authored. This artifact replaces the previously hardcoded `stage_motif_candidates` Rust table in `monomyth-gen`.

items.name: Call to Adventure → Ordaining the Future + Chance and Fate
items.description: The disrupting summons reads as a prophecy/fate-class motif.

items.name: Refusal of the Call → Traits of Character
items.description: Hesitation out of fear or duty is a personality-trait beat.

items.name: Supernatural Aid → Magic
items.description: The mentor's talisman or spell is Thompson's own magic-objects class.

items.name: Crossing the First Threshold → Marvels
items.description: Passage into the unknown is an otherworld-journey motif.

items.name: Belly of the Whale → The Dead
items.description: Symbolic death and passage matches resuscitation, ghosts, and the soul.

items.name: The Road of Trials → Tests
items.description: A direct match: tests of identity, cleverness, and prowess, and quests.

items.name: The Meeting with the Goddess → Sex
items.description: Unconditional love matches love, marriage, and courtship.

items.name: Woman as Temptress → Deceptions
items.description: Temptation leading the hero astray is deceits, disguises, and illusions.

items.name: Atonement with the Father → Society
items.description: The ultimate authority figure matches kings, courts, and institutions.

items.name: Apotheosis → Religion
items.description: Divine knowledge and transcendence is a direct match.

items.name: The Ultimate Boon → Rewards and Punishments
items.description: Winning the sought prize is a reward motif.

items.name: Refusal of the Return → Chance and Fate
items.description: Resisting the pull back to the ordinary world is a fate/fortune motif.

items.name: The Magic Flight → Captives and Fugitives
items.description: A direct match: escape, pursuit, and rescue.

items.name: Rescue from Without → Captives and Fugitives
The Crossing of the Return Threshold → Reversal of Fortune
items.description: Re-entry into ordinary life is a fortune-state change.

items.name: Master of the Two Worlds → The Wise and the Foolish
items.description: Balance and mastery matches the wisdom-and-cleverness class.

items.name: Freedom to Live → The Nature of Life
items.description: A direct match: reflective observations on the way of the world.
